summary: This bill establishes a diesel fuel tax holiday from its enactment until January 1, 2027, by setting the federal excise tax rate on diesel fuel to zero and ensuring that the foregone revenue is transferred from the general fund to the Highway Trust Fund and the Leaking Underground Storage Tank Trust Fund.

scores.thoughts: The bill mandates transfers from the general fund to the Highway Trust Fund and the Leaking Underground Storage Tank Trust Fund to offset the revenue loss from the diesel tax holiday. This direct transfer of funds from the general fund constitutes an increase in government spending to maintain the solvency of these trust funds despite the tax reduction.

The core purpose of this bill is to implement a temporary diesel fuel tax holiday, reducing the federal excise tax rate on diesel fuel to zero for a specified period. This directly lowers taxes on diesel fuel.

By reducing tax revenue from diesel fuel and requiring transfers from the general fund to trust funds, the bill would likely increase the federal deficit, thereby contributing to the national debt. The bill does not include any provisions to offset this revenue loss.

The bill suspends the federal excise tax on diesel fuel through 2026 and requires the Treasury to transfer equivalent amounts from the general fund to the Highway Trust Fund and LUST Trust Fund. This forgoes dedicated tax revenue without any offsetting revenue increases or spending reductions, directly increasing the federal deficit to provide the tax relief.
